# US2 Rework-Review Report (root review response, same session)

## (1) Concrete changes and why

**Approved cross-link fixes** — `LoginForm.tsx` / `RegisterForm.tsx` now preserve the validated same-locale `returnUrl` (full tour/date/count query) on the register/sign-in cross-links via `safeAuthReturnUrl`; unsafe/external/cross-locale inputs fall back to the plain form route. Submission, validation, auth SDK, and global context untouched.

**Rework 1 — BookingForm guards.** `parseSuppliedCount`: only `null` (missing param) defaults; explicit `''`/fractional/non-numeric/unsafe stay invalid. The accepted `getBookingSelectionView` now guards checkout at render **and** at submit (fresh UTC-day recheck, stale projection never POSTs): past/unlisted/unavailable/invalid bounds/amount/currency/overflow disable submit with precise catalog reasons + tour reselection route. Server 409/422/429/drift remain authoritative for valid projections. Known-signed-out checkout shows `continueNotice` + login/register full-query links instead of posting into a 401; restoration-pending disables submit. Fixture replaced with complete typed `createFullTourDetail` + injected `todayUtc` prop (no partial casts, no rotten 2026-08-01); F2/double-submit/price-drift/provider/reference paths preserved.

**Rework 2 — mobile bar.** Edit affordance preserved for valid selections. Spacer portaled to `document.body` end (after footer) with measured height; `--tour-booking-bar-height` + `scroll-padding-bottom` set on `documentElement`, removed on cleanup. Callback-ref observer restarts on unavailable→available transitions and disconnects on release. Stepper targets and the edit button are 44px (`min-h-11`); stepper is `role=group` + `output` value. Raw hex/gray/`z-30` replaced with proven semantic tokens (`bg-bookly-gold`, `hover:bg-accent-dark`, `text-bookly-navy`, `text-primary`, `text-text-muted`, `border-border`, `bg-surface`, `bg-surface-alt`, `text-trust`, warning tokens, `z-sticky`, `shadow-card`).

**Rework 3 — sticky geometry.** `sticky` moved from the card to the controller slot (`lg:sticky lg:top-20`), coordinating the existing `scroll-mt-20` nav offset; the slot lives in the full-height aside so the card spans the article. E2E asserts card top ≈80px beside reviews and card-bottom ≤ aside-bottom (unit pins classes only).

**Rework 4 — base display.** Controller derives one validated exact base from cents via the accepted formatter (`baseDisplay`, null when invalid — never a bogus zero); card/bar render it instead of raw `formatted`. Cancellation renders original text (trim used for presence only). Hidden test-only `booking-card-slug` / `mobile-bar-selection(-dialog)` spans and unused `slug` props removed; assertions use real hrefs/visible text.

**Rework 5 — continue-click guard.** One controller-owned `guardContinueClick` (passed to card, dialog, and bar links): rechecks the UTC day synchronously, `preventDefault`s stale selections into the localized reason + reselection, leaves valid clicks fully native (modifier-clicks intact).

**Rework 6 — auth builders.** One private `buildValidatedContinuation` backs both login and register builders (byte-identical outputs; accepted tests untouched). `buildCheckoutAuthRecoveryUrl` now builds through `buildCheckoutUrl` (no duplicated query logic); recovery keeps `sessionExpired` on the login URL only, booking return carries tour/participants/date exclusively.

**Rework 7 — E2E.** Both booking-creating tests capture the owned reference and cancel it in `finally` via the existing traveler cancel endpoint with an in-memory token (never logged); cancel failures attach the exact ref as a report annotation. New public cross-link journey: login→register→login keeps the full query end-to-end, then seeded login lands on the intact booking page. No DB resets, no shared-inventory abuse.

**Rework 8 — payment 401.** `DeterministicPaymentForm` is now real in `BookingForm.test`; new boundary test proves a 401 confirm surfaces failure, keeps the same reference/selection with `createBooking` still ×1, and a restored-auth retry pushes the **same** `ref` with no additional create POST. No redirect invented; provider logic untouched.

## (2) Files touched
Modified (owned/approved only): `auth/{LoginForm,RegisterForm}.tsx` + their tests, `booking/BookingForm.tsx` + tests, `tour/{TourBookingController,BookingCard,MobileBookingBar,AvailabilityCalendar,BookingCTA,MobileBookingAction,TourDetail}.tsx` + tour tests, `lib/tours/booking-selection.ts`, `lib/auth/__tests__/return-url.test.ts`, e2e `tour-detail.spec.ts`/`booking.spec.ts`, `globals.css` vars, `tours/[slug]/page.tsx`, `lib/tours/booking-reasons.ts` (new, unchanged this round). Untouched: `utils`, `StructuredData` + tests, `TourGallery.*`, tasks/verification/checklists, settings/competitor files. No staging/commit/reset.

## (3) Gates + evidence (`evidence/us2/`, all UTF-8, initial red intact)
- Rework reds: `rework-review-red-auth.txt` 2 failed/21; `rework-review-red-booking.txt` 7 failed/16; `rework-review-red-controller.txt` 3 failed/23 — all intended, compiling.
- Final greens (serial, `--runInBand --watchman=false`): auth+return-url+model **111/111**; BookingForm **16/16**; controller **23/23**; calendar+wrappers+detail+page **55/55**; controller+booking re-verified **39/39** against concurrent lanes.
- `npm run typecheck` exit 0 (whole tree); focused `npx eslint` on all 24 touched files exit 0; `playwright --list` on both e2e files exit 0 — 98 tests incl. new dialog/geometry/cross-link/cleanup cases.
- E2E logs: `rework-review-e2e-list.txt`; greens: `rework-review-final-*.txt`, `rework-review-green-*.txt`; typecheck/eslint finals saved.

## (4) Decisions, deviations, remaining runtime gaps
- Unit tests pin sticky classes only; real sticky/footer geometry is E2E-asserted for root's browser run. Touch-target minimums likewise proven by E2E bounding boxes, not jsdom.
- Cancellation `lang` attribute deferred to US6 (noted, not implemented).
- Login→register hop drops `sessionExpired` (register page has no such prop) — recovery explanation verified on the login leg; cross-page expiry-notice forwarding is a gap if root wants it.
- Payment-401 test labels its boundary (mocked confirm API); no claim of a redirect existing.
- `test-guard: clean`; `clean-code-guard: 4 fixed, 0 flagged` (cross-link const extraction, shared auth builder, bar effect restructure, duplicated recovery path removal). No skips, no eslint-disable added (one pre-existing in BookingForm idempotency memo kept), no literal-key assertions. No acceptance claimed; T032/T033 runtime remains root-owned.
